Sie unterstützen bei der Erstellung von Risikoberichten sowie bei der Kapitalplanung im regulatorischen Umfeld

Sie begleiten die jährliche Risikoinventur und erstellen aufsichtsrechtliche Meldungen für interne und externe Stellen
Darüber hinaus erstellen und pflegen Sie interne Richtlinien und treiben die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen voran

Du hast Erfahrung im Controlling und willst Deine analytischen Kenntnisse in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld einbringen? Du wünschst Dir einen sicheren Arbeitgeber, der Dir abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben und gute Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bietet?
In einem Leben ohne Klang ergibt unsere Arbeit einen Sinn. Als Tochtergesellschaft des schweizerischen Sonova-Konzerns fertigen wir, die AUDIA AKUSTIK GmbH in Sömmerda, Otoplastiken, Gehörschutz und Hörgerätezubehör. Gemeinsam schaffen wir Lösungen, die die Grenzen der Technologie erweitern und die Zukunft unserer Branche neu definieren.
Dabei reicht unser Beitrag weit über die Produktion hinaus: Von unserem Warehouse der Sonova Logistics in Erfurt aus versenden wir Hörgeräte in ganz Europa. Unterstütze uns dabei, Menschen den Genuss des Hörens und ein Leben ohne Einschränkungen zu ermöglichen.
Aufgaben
Du bereitest monatliche Reportings inklusive Abweichungsanalysen auf und wirkst bei der Erstellung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB und IFRS mit
Du unterstützt bei der Budgetplanung und bei der Erstellung von Forecasts.
Du überprüfst und stellst die Einhaltung der betriebswirtschaftlichen Konzernvorgaben sicher
Du entwickelst das Controlling-Instrumentarium weiter , wirkst im Rechnungswesen mit und bist Sparringspartner für operative Bereiche – auch bereichs- und standortübergreifend
Qualifikation
Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Controlling und Rechnungswesen oder über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation (z. B. Steuerfachangestellte)
Idealerweise bringst Du erste Berufserfahrung im Bereich Controlling und Finanzen sowie Kenntnisse in HGB, IFRS oder Steuerrecht mit. Auch Quereinsteiger mit starkem analytischem Denken sind willkommen
Du beherrschst den sicheren Umgang mit MS Office , insbesondere Excel. Idealerweise hast Du zusätzlich Erfahrung mit SAP
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab

Seit dem entwickelt WIP basierend auf amerikanischen Originalen eigene Carhartt WIP Kollektionen.
Carhartt Work In Progress steht für den Anspruch, sich stets weiterzuentwickeln ohne die eigenen Wurzeln aus dem Blick zu verlieren. Im Lauf der vergangenen drei Jahrzehnte ist unser Unternehmen organisch gewachsen. – Mit seiner Zeit. Mit seinen Kunden. Mit seinem kulturellen Umfeld. Und nicht zuletzt mit seinen Mitarbeitern, die Carhartt WIP maßgeblich prägen und durch neue Perspektiven bereichern.

Are you passionate about driving financial accuracy and compliance across international entities while making a real impact in a global organization?
Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people.
As our new Finance Controller , you will be ensuring high quality financial reporting across local and group standards, owning month-end and year-end closings, and serving as the go-to finance expert for Grundfos entities.
What you will be doing
As a key part of the Finance Controlling Team, you'll create impact by safeguarding financial integrity and compliance across Grundfos entities, enabling sound business decisions through accurate reporting under both IFRS and local GAAP standards.

Execute timely, high-quality month-end and year-end closing activities in the assigned companies while maintaining accurate local and group financial records
Serve as the primary point of contact for financial matters within local entities, ensuring compliance with all applicable regulations
Review and reconcile balance sheet and P&L accounts, and verify, analyze, and explain in group reporting
Manage Statutory financial statements, corporate income tax and other local compliance reporting in collaboration with external consultants in the assigned companies
Participate in internal and external audits, ensuring alignment with the Grundfos Internal Audit Handbook and timely completion
Collaborate with Finance Shared Services, the Finance Excellence team, and local departments on process improvements and group requirements
What makes you a great fit
Above all, you are a detail-oriented finance professional with strong accounting expertise, a structured approach to managing competing deadlines, and the flexibility to thrive in a dynamic, international environment. We would also imagine that you have:
2+ years of experience in a corporate finance or financial controlling role
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field
Solid knowledge of accounting principles, financial reporting (IFRS and/or local GAAP), and SAP
Professional proficiency in English
Familiarity with working remotely with stakeholders
Why you will love working here

Who we are Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

About the Team You'll join a small but high-impact Accounting & Controlling team at a pivotal moment in Typeform 's journey. As we've grown into a global SaaS business, our finance function is evolving to support greater scale, complexity, and ambition.

We're investing in stronger financial controls, more sophisticated accounting operations, and systems that will enable our next stage of growth. You'll partner closely with the VP of Accounting & Controlling, serving as their strategic deputy and helping lead both the day-to-day function and the longer-term evolution of our accounting organization.

Together, you'll build a world-class finance operation that is scalable, resilient, and ready for what's next. About the Role As Director of Accounting & Controlling, you'll lead the operational accounting function while helping shape the future of finance at Typeform .

Reporting to the VP of Accounting & Controlling, you'll own the integrity of our global accounting operations, oversee a growing team, and drive initiatives that strengthen financial controls, improve efficiency, and support international growth.

You'll combine technical accounting expertise with strong leadership and operational excellence, ensuring the business continues to scale on solid financial foundations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

You'll be a trusted partner to senior leadership, mentor and develop the accounting team, and play a key role in transforming how finance operates across the company.

As Controller, you will own the integrity of Revamp’s financial reporting and help strengthen the systems, processes, and data quality that power everything from project execution to company-wide decision-making.

Working closely with the VP of Finance & Operations and our outside accounting partners, you will lead the monthly close process, financial reporting, internal controls, forecasting, and financial analysis, lender compliance, audit readiness, tax and valuation support, and the financial narratives that leadership and employee-owners rely on.

A strong Controller will independently own the company's accounting integrity, make sound judgment calls with limited oversight, and build the finance function needed for the company's next stage of growth.

As part of an employee-owned firm founded to advance the global transition to renewable energy, this role has the opportunity to make an impact both internally and by moving our communities closer to a brighter, cleaner future.

Accounting Oversight + Financial Operations

Review the monthly close prepared by our outside accounting firm, including accruals, estimates, and support schedules; ensure issues are resolved before reporting.
Verify that accounting outputs reconcile to the budget, covenant calculations, and valuation model.
Exercise independent judgment on accruals, estimates, and accounting positions, and defend that judgment with outside advisors.
Step into lender, valuation, tax, and audit conversations as a prepared and credible backup to the VP of Finance & Operations.
Ensure compliance with GAAP, company policies, lender requirements, and applicable regulatory standards.
Prepare quarterly lender compliance packages, including covenant calculations, compliance certificates, agings, supporting schedules, and drafts of the management narrative.
Prepare the annual valuation package for the company's independent valuation firm, including financial data, projection support, and diligence responses.
Design, maintain, and improve internal controls over financial reporting and key business processes.
Drive continuous improvement of accounting and financial systems, reporting automation, and internal controls.
Own the corporate tax calendar and prepare supporting schedules, data, and draft reviews for the provision and returns prepared by outside tax advisors, including multi-state and international dimensions.
Serve as the primary point of contact for the annual financial statement audit and employee benefit plan audits (401(k) and ESOP), running the PBC process and audit calendar end to end and bringing judgment calls to the VP of Finance & Operations.

Planning, Analysis + Communications

Run the annual budget and quarterly reforecast, coordinating schedule production with the outside accounting firm and owning the analysis and narrative.
Maintain the rolling 12-month forecast, including revenue, labor costs, and cash flow.
Monitor cash position, liquidity, and working capital needs while supporting banking and treasury relationships.
Develop portfolio projections, including backlog conversion and pipeline-weighted revenue.
Develop driver-based forecasting and scenario analysis to support leadership decisions on hiring, pricing, and growth.
Partner with operational leaders to develop actionable performance metrics and improve business decision-making.
Produce the monthly financial reporting package for the leadership team.
Develop and deliver regular financial communications to leadership and to all staff, translating financial results and structure for an audience of employee-owners.
Build and maintain the company's key metrics framework, including definitions, data sources, and tracking cadence.
Conduct periodic audits of the operational data (project accounting, time and billing systems) that feeds close, billing, and reporting, and drive corrections at the source.

Quality + Collaboration

Participate in leadership and project meetings and communicate financial work clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
Coordinate with outside accountants, tax advisors, auditors, valuation professionals, and lenders.
Collaborate with billing operations, project management, and department leaders to deliver accurate and complete financial work.
Contribute to a team culture rooted in accountability, curiosity, quality, and shared commitment to Revamp's clean energy mission and values of Impact, Collaboration, Trust, and Equity.
Mentor finance staff by answering technical questions, reviewing work, and modeling strong practices.
Lead the continued development of the finance function by strengthening processes, enhancing systems, and expanding internal capabilities.
Perform essential duties, including meeting deliverables and deadlines.

Required

Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or a related discipline.
Active CPA required; inactive CPA or CMA considered with equivalent experience.
10+ years of progressive accounting experience in industry or a combination of public accounting and industry roles.
Demonstrated experience building or rebuilding an accounting function, leading a team, and supporting external stakeholders (lenders, auditors, valuation firms, or investors).
Progressive accounting experience, including having personally led a monthly close process and designed, implemented, or improved accounting close procedures.
Working knowledge of GAAP, corporate tax compliance processes, and financial statement audit support.

Mit Ihrer wertvollen Arbeit bei den PDGR leisten Sie einen Beitrag zu mehr Lebensqualität für unsere Patienten, Bewohnerinnen, betreuten Angestellten und Schüler.
Neben dieser täglichen sinnstiftenden Tätigkeit für den Patienten und die Gesellschaft bieten wir unseren Mitarbeitenden noch vieles mehr:
Ferien
Abschalten vom intensiven Arbeitsalltag - Ihre körperliche und geistige Erholung ist wichtig. Unser Arbeitszeitmodell ist so aufgebaut, dass alle Mitarbeitenden über das Jahr eine Woche Arbeitszeit vorarbeiten. Von diesem Vorholen der Arbeitszeit profitieren Sie mit bis zu einer Woche zusätzlicher Ferientage (Kompensationstage).
Wie alt sind Sie? Der Ferienanspruch ist bei uns altersabhängig. Mitarbeitende bis 49 Jahre profitieren mit diesem Arbeitszeitmodell von 6 Wochen Ferien pro Jahr, Mitarbeitende von 50 bis 59 Jahre von 6.5 Wochen und Mitarbeitende ab 60 Jahre von 7 Wochen.

Sie sind ein aktiver, geselliger Mensch? Unser Freizeitclub PDGR-AKTIV, der allen Mitarbeitenden offen steht, organisiert vielseitige Aktivitäten - ob Besuche im Bündner Kunstmuseum, Paintball-Wettkämpfe oder das Erklimmen verschiedener bekannter Bündner Berge - es hat für jeden etwas dabei. Haben Sie eigene Vorschläge? Bringen Sie diese ein oder organisieren Sie direkt selber einen Anlass.
Verwaltung bewegt
Profitieren Sie vom umfangreichen, gesundheitsfördernden Sport-Angebot der Kantonalen Verwaltung. Yogakurse, Nordic Walking, Gruppensportarten - stöbern Sie im attraktiven Programm von «Verwaltung bewegt».
Fitnessräume
Trainieren während sieben Tagen in der Woche? Die modern eingerichteten Fitnessräume in den Kliniken Beverin und Waldhaus nutzen Sie kostenfrei.
Minigolfanlage Beverin
Unsere Minigolfanlage liegt mitten in der ruhigen Umgebung der Klinik Beverin. Spielen Sie mit Freunden, der Familie oder mit Ihrem Team zu einem vergünstigten Preis.
Gesundes Essen
Unsere Küchencrews an den Standorten Beverin, Rothenbrunnen, Therapiehaus Fürstenwald und Waldhaus bieten Ihnen abwechslungsreiche und gesunde Mahlzeiten - zu einem vergünstigten Preis. Wir wünschen Ihnen «a Guata»!
Apfel- und Birnenaktion
Traditionsgemäss sorgt unsere 3-wöchige Apfel- und Birnenaktion im Herbst für eine energiereiche Zwischenverpflegung.
E-Bikes
Sie haben einen Termin in der Stadt? Nutzen Sie die PDGR E-Bikes für eine umweltfreundliche und nachhaltige An- und Rückreise.
Theaterverein Muntanellas
Sie spielen gerne Theater? Der PDGR-nahe Theaterverein Muntanellas bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, kreativ zu sein, in andere Rollen zu schlüpfen, Geschichten zu erzählen und der Leidenschaft fürs Theaterspiel nachzugehen.
13. Monatslohn
Selbstverständlich? Längst nicht alle Unternehmungen bieten einen 13. Monatslohn an. Bei uns ist die Auszahlung des 13. Monatslohnes selbstverständlich.
Besondere Sozialzulagen
Unseren Mitarbeitenden mit Kindern bieten wir, neben der Kinderzulage, besondere Sozialzulagen an. Die besondere Sozialzulage wird pro Familie ausgerichtet und ist abhängig vom Beschäftigungsumfang.
Berufliche Vorsorge
Unsere Mitarbeitenden profitieren von einer hervorragenden beruflichen Vorsorge mit attraktiven Leistungen der PKGR. Die PDGR leisten dabei einen überdurchschnittlichen Arbeitgeberbeitrag, der die gesetzliche Vorgabe deutlich übersteigt, was Ihre finanzielle Zukunft zusätzlich stärkt.
Beiträge an Kinderbetreuung
Berufstätige Eltern sind uns wichtig. Damit Sie Job und Familie optimal aufeinander abstimmen können, beteiligen wir uns an den Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung.
Zulagen
Arbeiten Sie nachts oder an Sonn- und Feiertagen? Diese Einsätze werden Ihnen finanziell entschädigt.
Leistungsprämien
Erbringen Sie ausserordentliche Leistungen oder haben Sie sich im hohen Masse engagiert? Dieser besondere Einsatz kann mit einer Leistungsprämie belohnt werden.
Spontanprämien
Die Bereichsleitungen können mit Spontanprämien besondere Leistungen ihrer Mitarbeitenden honorieren oder Teamanlässe damit finanzieren. Die Spontanprämien sind steuerfrei.
Unbezahlter Urlaub
Wollen Sie eine Auszeit nehmen? Wir geben unser Bestes, um Ihren unbezahlten Urlaub zu ermöglichen. Die Beantragung ist schnell und unkompliziert.
Externe Fort- und Weiterbildungen
Beabsichtigen Sie im Rahmen Ihrer Funktion bei den PDGR eine externe Fort- und Weiterbildung? Wir beteiligen uns wenn möglich an den Kosten - besprechen Sie Ihr Anliegen mit Ihrem Vorgesetzten.

Spreedly is the world's leading Open Payments Platform. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, the company gives mid-market and enterprise businesses the infrastructure to connect to any payment gateway, processor, or fraud tool through a single API. The platform is vendor-agnostic by design, meaning customers are never locked into a single provider and never need to rebuild their payments stack to access new capabilities.
The core business problem Spreedly solves is real and costly: global merchants face a fragmented payments ecosystem, where every new market, payment method, or fraud tool typically requires a separate, time-consuming integration. Spreedly eliminates that complexity, enabling companies to route transactions intelligently, secure cardholder data, prevent fraud, and expand into new markets without heavy engineering overhead.

Spreedly is looking for a Controller to lead our accounting function and help build a more automated, scalable operating environment. Reporting to the VP of Finance, you'll own accounting across the business while partnering closely with FP&A and cross-functional leaders.
This is an opportunity for an experienced accounting leader who wants meaningful autonomy, enjoys solving complex problems, and knows what great systems and processes look like.

Our usage-based model — including contracts with commitments, overages, and usage billed in arrears — creates accounting challenges beyond those found in a typical SaaS environment.

You'll be the steward of our finance systems, including NetSuite, Orb, and Ramp, and a driving force behind modernizing how the accounting function runs, including where automation and AI tools can remove manual work.

Lead the accounting function, with responsibility for accurate books and a timely, consistent close
Oversee core accounting areas including financial statements, accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll, revenue recognition, treasury, tax, and audit
Own and improve the accounting systems stack, including NetSuite, Orb, and Ramp, ensuring data integrity across integrations
Assess current workflows and implement practical systems automation and AI-enabled processes
Build scalable processes and controls that support the company as it grows, including SOC 2 / audit readiness
Navigate accounting for usage-based contracts, including commitments, overages, and billing in arrears
Review SaaS and usage-based customer contracts for revenue recognition impact under ASC 606, partnering with Legal and Sales on rev rec-sensitive terms
Lead and develop the accounting team, including determining the most effective reporting structure
Partner cross-functionally with FP&A, Legal, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, and other teams on contracts and business decisions
Own the annual financial statement audit and any tax examinations, coordinating with external auditors and tax advisors
Oversee corporate tax compliance (income, sales/use, and other filings) in partnership with outside tax advisors
Bring a clear point of view on what good looks like and translate it into better systems, processes, and team practices

Additional Information

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:
Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.

s.h: What It's Like to Work Here
s.t:
We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity.
--
We champion the ethical, creative use of AI—if you’re someone who pairs human judgment with modern AI tools to work smarter and drive bigger impact, you’ll thrive here.
--
Spreedly is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We actively work to drive out even unintentional discrimination in our hiring processes via practices like blindly graded work samples, structured interviews, and diversity awareness training.

Stellenbeschreibung Du reportest nicht, was passiert ist. Du sorgst dafür, dass wir wissen, was als Nächstes passieren muss. Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen und gehört zu den am schnellsten wachsenden E-Commerce-Unternehmen Europas.
Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende an unseren Standorten in Hamburg, Kiel und unserem eigenen 22.0 00 m² Logistikzentrum in Lensahn daran, aus Pammys eine globale Footwear Brand zu machen.
Mit einem Umsatz im mittleren 8-stelligen Bereich, mehreren Millionen Euro Marketinginvestitionen pro Monat, internationalem Wachstum und einem Produktvolumen in Millionenhöhe wird eine Sache immer wichtiger:
Finanzielle Steuerung auf höchstem Niveau.
Deshalb bauen wir unser Controlling massiv aus und suchen vier (Senior) Controller / Finance Business Partner (m/w/d) , die gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase steuern.
Bei uns geht es nicht darum, Excel-Dateien zu verwalten oder rückblickend Zahlen zusammenzufassen.
Du sitzt nah an den Entscheidungen, challengest Annahmen, erkennst Abweichungen frühzeitig und übersetzt Zahlen in konkrete Maßnahmen.
Dein Ziel: Wachstum profitabel machen und jederzeit wissen, welche Stellschraube den größten finanziellen Impact hat.
Je nach Erfahrung und Schwerpunkt übernimmst du Verantwortung für einen oder mehrere unserer zentralen Unternehmensbereiche wie Marketing & E-Commerce, Product & Sourcing, Operations & Logistics oder Corporate Finance .
Deine Aufgaben Du übernimmst als Finance Business Partner die finanzielle Steuerung eines oder mehrerer zentraler Unternehmensbereiche und arbeitest eng mit den jeweiligen Führungskräften zusammen.
Du steuerst relevante KPIs, Budgets und Ergebnisgrößen und stellst sicher, dass Abweichungen nicht nur erkannt, sondern aktiv adressiert werden.
Du analysierst unsere P&L und Deckungsbeiträge bis auf Produkt-, Kanal-, Markt- oder Kostenstellenebene und identifizierst konkrete Ergebnishebel.
Du erstellst Forecasts, Szenarioanalysen und Business Cases und zeigst transparent, welchen finanziellen Effekt unterschiedliche Entscheidungen haben.
Du begleitest unsere Budget- und Jahresplanung und entwickelst sie zu einem dynamischen Steuerungsinstrument weiter.
Du analysierst Kostenentwicklungen und hinterfragst bestehende Strukturen konsequent auf Effizienz, Skalierbarkeit und Profitabilität .
Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Finance und Data aussagekräftige Management-Reportings, Dashboards und Frühwarnsysteme .
Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Führungskräfte jederzeit die Zahlen kennen, die sie für ihre Entscheidungen tatsächlich benötigen.
Du verbindest operative KPIs mit finanziellen Auswirkungen und schaffst so Transparenz darüber, wo wir Geld verdienen, verlieren oder investieren sollten .
Du entwickelst klare Zielbilder, Benchmarks und Performance-KPIs für deine Verantwortungsbereiche und begleitest deren Umsetzung.
Du unterstützt bei Liquiditätsplanung, Cashflow-Steuerung und Working Capital Management .
Du analysierst Bestände, Einkauf, Zahlungsziele und Kapitalbindung und identifizierst Potenziale zur Verbesserung unseres Cash Conversion Cycles.
Du baust unsere Controlling-Prozesse weiter auf und treibst Automatisierung, Standardisierung und Digitalisierung konsequent voran.
Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Finance, Accounting, Data sowie den operativen Fachbereichen zusammen.
Dein Profil Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in BWL, Finance, Controlling, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Controlling, FP&A oder Finance Business Partnering mit.
Besonders spannend ist Erfahrung aus E-Commerce, D2C, Retail, Fashion, FMCG oder einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen .
Du verstehst eine P&L nicht nur technisch, sondern kannst erklären, welche operative Entscheidung hinter einer Veränderung steckt .
Begriffe wie Contribution Margin, Cashflow, Working Capital, Forecast und Business Case gehören zu deinem täglichen Werkzeug.
Du bist extrem sicher in Excel oder Google Sheets und kannst auch große Datenmengen strukturiert analysieren.
Erfahrung mit BI-Tools, ERP-Systemen und automatisierten Reportings ist ein großes Plus.
Du arbeitest analytisch und präzise, verlierst dich aber nicht in Analysen, sondern kommst schnell zu einer klaren Empfehlung.
Du hast den Anspruch, Zahlen zu challengen , statt sie lediglich entgegenzunehmen.
Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte so erklären, dass auch Nicht-Finanzler unmittelbar verstehen, was zu tun ist.
Du arbeitest eigenständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und fühlst dich in einem Umfeld wohl, in dem Entscheidungen schnell getroffen und Ergebnisse klar gemessen werden.

Take full ownership of the company's accounting operations and General Ledger.
Become the internal QuickBooks expert for the organization.
Work directly with the CFO and play a key role in strengthening the finance function.
Lead the transition from outsourced accounting to a fully in-house operation.

QuickBooks & General Ledger

Tax & Accounting Controls
Coordinate payroll tax, sales tax, and 1099-related matters.
Execute accounting policies established by the CFO accurately and consistently.
Maintain strong accounting controls and a high standard of accuracy.

Prior experience as a Financial Controller, Senior Accountant, or similar senior accounting professional with full ownership of the General Ledger.
Advanced, hands-on QuickBooks expertise.

Controller, Accounting Operations & FP&A
Join a remote-first, sponsor-backed professional services business at a stage where the finance function is becoming a true growth lever. This is an internal Controller role for someone who is already strong in accounting operations and wants a broader seat across faster close, cleaner reporting, FP&A support, acquisition integration, automation, and direct partnership with senior finance and executive leadership.
The Opportunity
The company is scaling through a mix of core services growth, new offerings, and acquisition activity. The finance team needs a hands-on Controller who can keep the accounting engine accurate and dependable while helping modernize how the business closes, reports, forecasts, and integrates new lines of business.
This is not a narrow bookkeeping seat, and it is not a hands-off VP Finance role. It is ideal for a highly capable Controller who wants to stay close to the GL, own the accounting operating cadence, and build toward broader FP&A and strategic finance exposure over time.
What You Will Own
Accounting Operations
Own day-to-day accounting operations across payroll, accounts receivable, accounts payable, reconciliations, month-end close, and reporting workflows.
Lead the close process with a focus on speed, accuracy, reviewability, and repeatability.
Maintain clean financial records that support leadership reporting, board reporting, audit readiness, and future lender-related data requests.
Oversee and develop one direct report in a senior accountant / accounting specialist capacity.
Support required registrations, compliance-related finance administration, and other operational finance needs as they arise.
Reporting, FP&A, and Leadership Support
Build and improve financial reporting packages so leadership can review results earlier, identify insights faster, and make better decisions.
Support monthly variance analysis, fluctuation analysis, forecasting, budgeting, and longer-term planning exercises.
Help prepare operational finance inputs for board reporting, annual budgeting, sponsor-backed reporting, audit readiness, and valuation-related needs.
Partner with the finance leader on lender-facing data preparation if and when the company moves into lender relationships.
Translate accurate accounting outputs into useful finance insights for a scaling professional services business.
Systems, Automation, and Process Modernization
Assess the current finance and accounting tech stack and help determine what should be automated, upgraded, or replaced over time.
Improve capacity in the controller function through better processes and tools rather than simply adding headcount.
Identify opportunities to automate month-end close, reconciliations, AP workflows, reporting packages, and recurring data pulls.
Support future ERP, accounting system, forecasting tool, or related finance systems implementation work.
Acquisition Integration
Help integrate accounting operations for a recently acquired business line currently relying on informal or part-time bookkeeping support.
Create a more scalable accounting process for the acquired business, including fixed-price services revenue and related reporting.
Support acquisition-related accounting integration work such as GL alignment, reporting consistency, data cleanup, and operating cadence.
Bring practical judgment to a business where acquisition activity and integration work are expected to remain part of the finance environment.
What Makes You a Strong Fit
You have strong Controller-level experience owning accounting operations in a smaller or mid-sized business where finance and accounting responsibilities are not overly siloed.
You are comfortable being accountable for the GL, close, reporting accuracy, and accounting process discipline.
You have meaningful exposure to FP&A, forecasting, variance analysis, budgeting, or board reporting, even if your core strength is still accounting.
You have worked in a sponsor-backed, PE-backed, VC-backed, or similarly high-accountability environment where speed, reporting quality, and leadership visibility matter.
You have experience with professional services, project-based accounting, fixed-price services revenue, or other operationally complex revenue models.
You can support a business with a mix of services and subscription-style revenue, even if project-based accounting has been the more complex part of your background.
You have either participated in acquisition integration work before or have strong adjacent experience organizing new entities, business lines, systems, and reporting flows.
You are comfortable working directly with senior finance leadership and being a reliable leverage point for better reporting, analysis, and operating cadence.
You are hands-on, fast, precise, and willing to improve the process while still doing the underlying accounting work well.
Nice-to-Haves
ERP implementation, accounting system implementation, forecasting tool implementation, or finance systems modernization experience.
Automation experience across close, reconciliations, AP, reporting, or recurring finance workflows.
Experience preparing data for lenders, debt reporting, covenant tracking, or quarterly lender packages.
Familiarity with government contracting, federal contractor environments, regulated services businesses, or compliance-heavy operating models.
Experience in a multi-service-line business with project-based, fixed-price, managed services, and subscription-style revenue.
Audit support experience in a sponsor-backed or acquisition-oriented environment.
The First 90 Days
First 30 Days
Learn the current accounting operations, reporting cadence, systems, team structure, and business model.
Identify the biggest opportunities to streamline month-end close and reporting package preparation.
Begin improving reporting workflows so leadership can review results earlier and with more confidence.
First 60 Days
Take meaningful ownership of integrating accounting operations for the recently acquired business line.
Move acquired-business accounting away from informal or part-time support toward a scalable internal process.
Continue tightening the monthly close and recurring reporting cadence.
First 90 Days
Establish a clearer operating rhythm across close, reporting, finance inputs, and leadership review.
Help prepare for upcoming budgeting, audit, valuation, and sponsor-backed reporting needs.
Build a practical roadmap for finance tech stack improvements and automation opportunities.
Who This Role Is Best For
This role is a strong fit if you are already a highly capable Controller and want your next role to stretch beyond traditional accounting operations. You may be earlier in your career than a VP Finance, but you have the judgment, technical accounting foundation, and operating pace to become a broader finance leader over time.
You will likely enjoy this role if you are energized by a scaling sponsor-backed company, direct exposure to finance leadership, building structure without a fully built playbook, and making accounting faster, cleaner, and more useful to the business.

CAPEX Planner/Controller
========================
Join a major pharmaceutical CAPEX programme in Visp, taking ownership of integrated project planning and schedule control across complex, high\-value investments from design through commissioning and start\-up.
CAPEX Planner/Controller
========================

* Develop, maintain, and manage integrated project schedules across all CAPEX project phases, from concept design through commissioning and start\-up.
* Establish baseline schedules, project milestones, schedule assumptions, and schedule basis documentation for stakeholder approval.
* Ensure schedules accurately reflect current project scope, resources, execution strategy, dependencies, and key milestones.
* Support resource planning and resource\-loaded scheduling where required.
* Track project progress against approved baselines and identify schedule deviations, trends, and potential delays.
* Perform critical path and near\-critical path analysis to evaluate schedule risk and project impacts.
* Develop mitigation and recovery strategies in response to delays or schedule performance issues.
* Maintain accurate records of scope changes, delays, trends, and schedule variances.
* Produce regular schedule reports, dashboards, forecasts, trend analysis, and performance metrics.
* Present schedule status, key risks, critical issues, and recovery plans to project teams and senior stakeholders.
* Facilitate planning workshops and interactive scheduling sessions.
* Collaborate closely with Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Commissioning teams.
* Conduct regular schedule reviews to validate progress and forecast project completion.
* Ensure scheduling data remains accurate, reliable, and aligned with project controls standards and best practices.

The business operates within highly regulated pharmaceutical and biotechnology environments, delivering large\-scale engineering programmes across design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and start\-up.

This position offers exposure to significant CAPEX investments, including mega\-projects exceeding CHF 300 million, and requires close collaboration with engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and project leadership teams. The role is based in Visp and follows a hybrid model of four days on site and one day working from home.

* Experience with **CHF 20m\+ projects from design through commissioning/start\-up**, including exposure to **CHF 300m\+ mega\-projects**.

Controllership of our proprietary credit offerings over our 3 Tide Capital companies with varying credit products.

Represent the finance team at the Credit Risk Working Group and Risk and Compliance Committee.
Building robust financial control processes and strengthening internal controls.
Maintain strong balance sheet controls with monthly substantiation.

Collating financial data for the preparation of corporation tax ensuring compliance with tax legislation.

What We’re All About.
Quantexa is a global leader in AI-powered Decision Intelligence. As one of the UK's fastest-growing tech companies, we're on a mission to help organisations make better, more trusted decisions. As we continue our rapid global expansion, we are looking for a commercially minded and technically strong finance professional to join our dynamic finance team.
At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.
The opportunity.
What you’ll be doing.
We are seeking an experienced Financial Lead in processes and control to help modernise and scale a global finance function operating across a complex, multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction environment.
Reporting to the VP Finance, you will lead initiatives that improve the effectiveness, efficiency and scalability of Finance through process redesign, technology enablement, data governance and operational excellence.
This role sits at the intersection of finance operations, systems, data and business performance. You will be responsible for transforming core finance processes, improving controls, implementing enabling technologies and ensuring that transformation initiatives deliver measurable and sustainable business value.
Unlike a traditional programme management role, success will not be measured solely by project delivery. You will be expected to challenge assumptions, validate outcomes and ensure that process and system changes translate into tangible improvements in close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness and decision-making.
You will play a key role in consolidating information from a diverse systems landscape, improving data quality and governance, and helping establish a single source of truth for financial and operational reporting.

Finance Process Transformation & Operational Excellence
Assist in the design and implementation of the Finance Target Operating Model (TOM), covering processes, systems and data, providing input and recommendations to support the overall TOM design.
Develop and maintain a transformation roadmap aligned to business objectives, operational efficiency, governance requirements and future compliance needs, including SOX readiness.
Analyse and redesign finance processes to improve productivity, control effectiveness and user experience.
Identify control gaps, operational risks and process inefficiencies, developing practical and prioritised remediation plans.
Establish robust data governance, validation and reporting frameworks to improve the quality, consistency and reliability of financial information.
Map and optimise end-to-end transaction flows across multiple systems and data sources.
Support the creation of scalable reporting and analytics capabilities that provide meaningful operational and financial insight.
Finance Systems & Automation
Lead finance systems and automation projects from initial requirements through to implementation and post-go-live stabilisation.
Partner with Finance and Technology teams to evaluate, select and implement solutions that support future-state finance operations.
Drive automation opportunities across close processes, journal management, reconciliations, variance analysis and reporting.
Ensure data integrity, auditability and control considerations are embedded within all system and process changes.
Establish governance standards for financial data, system ownership and ongoing process maintenance.
Programme Delivery & Change Management
Apply disciplined project and programme management practices including planning, risk management, benefits tracking, stakeholder communication and delivery governance.
Define success measures and ensure transformation benefits are tracked, validated and sustained over time.
Build engagement and buy-in across the finance organisation by clearly communicating objectives, priorities and expected outcomes.
Support teams through process, technology and organisational change, ensuring successful adoption of new ways of working.
Translate complex finance, operational and technology challenges into clear and actionable implementation plans.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management
Partner with senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, Legal, Operations and commercial functions to align transformation priorities with wider business objectives.
Act as a trusted advisor on finance process, controls, systems and operating model design.
Work alongside finance teams to resolve complex operational challenges, improve processes and implement best practices.
Provide regular reporting to senior leadership on programme progress, risks, benefits realisation and key transformation milestones.
Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and operational excellence across the finance function.

Essential.
Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, ICAS, or equivalent).
Proven experience operating at Head of Finance / Financial Controller level, with broad oversight of the full accounting cycle (AP through to management accounts).
Demonstrated experience with multi-GAAP statutory accounting across multiple entities/jurisdictions.
Deep understanding of controllership processes: financial close cycles, account reconciliation, consolidation, intercompany accounting, journal entry management, and statutory reporting.
Track record of successfully leading financial systems/process implementation projects (e.g. ERP implementation, close process redesign, close automation tooling).
Demonstrated ability to design and implement future-state close operating models covering process, automation, controls, data, and people.
Strong project management skills and experience, ideally with formal methodology exposure (e.g. Agile, Prince2, or similar).
Experience leading teams through significant change, with a genuine ability to bring people along on the journey.
Comfortable being hands-on and detail-oriented while also operating strategically.
Desirable.
Hands-on implementation or advisory experience with one or more close automation or EPM platforms (e.g. FloQast, BlackLine, OneStream, Prophix, or comparable).
Experience in a fast-growing, multi-entity, international business (SaaS/technology sector a plus).
Experience with modern finance/ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, Workday, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) and reporting/automation tools.
Familiarity with the intersection between close quality, internal controls, and external audit.
Prior experience partnering with Legal, HR, and commercial teams on cross-functional finance matters.
PMP / PRINCE2 / Agile certification, or a Lean Six Sigma qualification.
